card.name: First digit of two-digit numbers
card.fires_on: The first digit (or occasionally the second) of a two- or three-digit number, such as a label section number like 12.4 or 14.1 inside a bracketed cross-reference, or the start of a dose range number.

modes.label: Section cross-references
modes.description: The leading 1 of section numbers like 12.4 or 14.1 in bracketed see-references.

modes.label: Dose range numbers
modes.description: The first digit of a number starting a dose range in mg or mg/kg.
